title: Psalm 54: Save Me by Your Name
summary: Betrayed by people who should have protected him, David asks God to save and vindicate him by his name and might. Ruthless men seek his life without regard for God, but David declares that God is his helper and the sustainer of his life. He promises a freewill offering and thanks God for delivering him from every trouble.

from.where: The Study Bible's notes on Psalm 54
from.text: Psalm 54 is one of the shortest laments in the Psalter

line: Betrayed by people who should have protected him, David asks God to save him by his name, declares God his helper, and promises a freewill offering of thanks.
guide: This short psalm moves from fear to trust in seven verses, turning at verse 4. Its prayer against enemies is left to God, not acted out. Let it end where it ends, in a gift given freely.

verses.t: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. When the Ziphites went to Saul and said, “Is David not hiding among us?” Save me, O God, by Your name, and vindicate me by Your might!
Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.
For strangers rise up against me, and ruthless men seek my life— men with no regard for God. Selah
Surely God is my helper; the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.
He will reward my enemies with evil. In Your faithfulness, destroy them.
Freely I will sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for it is good.
For He has delivered me from every trouble, and my eyes have stared down my foes.
